app.title: HSYNC
field.lan_persistent: Persistent (keep retrying when no peer is found)
field.lan_require_pairing: Strict pairing (confirm the master certificate out of band)
note.lan_secure: LAN transport is always encrypted (HTTPS/WSS). The master keeps a persistent identity and peers pin its certificate on first contact.
field.delta_min_size: Delta min file size - server (bytes, 0 = default)
field.delta_min_size_lan: Delta min file size - LAN (bytes, 0 = default)
note.autotune: Auto-tuning probes the network and storage at startup and derives adaptive defaults for timeout, retry, and concurrency. Leave the fields below empty to use the auto-tuned values.
field.ntp_hosts: NTP hosts (comma-separated; used for LAN time synchronisation)
role.never_master: Never master (syncs both ways but never becomes master)
log.title: Application log
note.connect_lan: Run this command on another device to connect it directly to this NAS. Replace the local folder with the folder to sync on that device.
note.connect_server: This NAS runs in server mode and connects to a central HSYNC server. To sync another device with the same data, point it at the same server URL and bucket.
